corrections.priorText: Start/status/stop operate real background process; generated helper calls add/recall/read/update successfully through socket
corrections.newText: Start/status/stop operate real background process; generated helper calls add/recall/reinforce/list/stats/reflect/traverse successfully through socket
corrections.reason: Initial inventory overstatement. Documentation promises add/recall; the public helper actually exports add, recall, reinforce, list, stats, reflect and traverse. No documentation/source promise for a generated helper read/update API was found. Socket server operations were incorrectly conflated with generated helper exports.
corrections.basis: README/docs and public source only; test outcomes did not determine the correction.
